In this returning season of FINDING, six heartfelt reunions honour people who left a lasting mark. Nearly 40 years after Basic Military Training, Minister Ong Ye Kung searches for his BMT buddy Eric, while actor-host Noah Yap reunites with Ma’am Haiyan, the mentor who believed in him and supported his family through difficult times. Actor Elvin Ng and his mother travel to Indonesia to surprise Jumi, the domestic helper who became their pillar of strength, while 23-year-old Leticia journeys to Central Java to thank Auntie Mas, who helped raise her for 12 years. Dino Isaac reconnects with the Primary 3 teacher whose kindness gave him hope after a traumatic childhood, while radio DJ Gerald Koh and conservation educator John Chua surprise the teachers who inspired and guided them. Together, these emotional journeys celebrate friendship, gratitude and the lasting impact of those who quietly shape lives.

Man Wai-sum retired from the media six months ago. With a background in marketing management, Kingston Koo is abruptly appointed as director. Deputy Director Cheung Ka-yin takes over Leung King-yan’s status but struggles to gain the respect of her colleagues. Wai-sum makes a strong comeback as the Queen of News, acquiring the online media platform founded by Lau Yim and challenges conventional mainstream media. 文慧心（佘诗曼饰）退隐新闻界半年，SNK生巨变。市场管理出身的古肇华（黄宗泽饰）空降总监一职，视新闻为赚钱工具；副总监张家妍（李施嬅饰）取代了梁景仁（马国明饰）的地位，纵握大权却难服众。慧心以“新闻女王”姿态强势回归，收购刘艳（王敏奕饰）创办的网媒公开平台，向传统主流媒体发起挑战。KOL唐芷瑶（陈晓华饰）利用自媒体，对慧心展开恶意狙击。

Every Body Knows is a talkshow that advocates healthy lifestyle! Doctors, TCM physicians and nutritionist will share their knowledge and addressing on common myth or health issues. Mark Lee, Lee Teng & Kym Ng will take turn to host. Hence, be sure to catch this show! 《医聊大小事》是一档倡导健康生活、关注全民健康的保健节目。医生、中医师、营养师将呈现与示范最实用的健康贴士、筛查、食疗等。主持人李国煌、李腾和鐘琴的妙语如珠，将让资讯变得浅而易懂。千万别错过这一档可以一起长知识的节目！

Plus, PSLE can make dads anxious too! Three fathers share how they learned to let go. Beyond grades, what can parents give their children to help them go further?

Li Zhongcheng was a HDB officer in the 90s. Thirty years later, his son Yiwei follows his path and reconnects with childhood friends Fang Ying and Daping. Ying, a renovator, resents her absent father, while Daping is a scammer. Yiwei reunites with his long-lost brother Jiewei, only to face his revenge—and learns he caused Ying’s misfortunes. 90年代组屋保姆李忠诚热心助人，其子奕伟和杰伟，与方颖、达平及Kumar皆童年玩伴情深。30年后奕伟继承父志当组屋保姆，意外重逢装修商方颖，却发现童年好友达平沦为骗子且性格扭曲。方颖怨父弃家与母相依为命；奕伟终寻回被拐弟弟杰伟，却遭弟弟怀恨蓄意报复。更震惊发现，方颖的坎坷人生竟是自己造成……

A petty official in the Tang Dynasty is given the impossible task of delivering fresh lychee from Lingnan to Imperial Consort Yang's birthday banquet in Chang'an, a distance of over 2500 kilometers. He has three months to make the impossible possible. The penalty for failure is death for him and slavery for his family.

The story of a group of individuals with different backgrounds were unexpectedly drawn into a mysterious treasure-hunting journey during the late Qing Dynasty. Amidst the grand and tumultuous historical tide, would they succeed, would their ultimate goals be realized, and would they be the heroes of their generation?

Xu Wei Hao was born with a silver spoon. After the decline of his family wealth, he remains unambitious, even his daughter looks down on him. Wei Hao's neighbor, Li Zheng Yi, is a cowardly cop. He is in a relationship with Liu Xue Hua, a single mother and they live together. Her children refuse to accept him as their stepfather. Xue Hua refuse to forgive her ex-husband, Chen Kai, who has just been released from prison. The three men accidentally ate mysterious chocolates ... 许伟豪出身富裕的伟豪，在家道中落后依旧缺乏进取心，连女儿也看不起他。住在伟豪同层楼的邻居李正义是个胆小怕事的警察，他与单亲妈妈刘雪华交往并同住在一屋檐下，可是雪华的儿女却拒绝接受这个小男人当后父。雪华无法原谅刚出狱的前夫陈凯，还告诉他孩子们也不会认这个作奸犯科的爸爸。三个男人人无意中吃了神秘巧克力…

Modern women with new-age beliefs. Is marriage really hell or bliss? Papa Hao is a widowed restaurant chef who single-handedly raised three daughters. Eldest daughter Meiman is a successful advertising agent who believes that women should always place career before marriage. Ironic to her extravagant lifestyle, Meiman ends up with her miserly colleague whom she bickers with incessantly from workplace to home.. Second daughter Meili is a TV producer who yearns to start a family but is always rejected by her matchmaking prospects because of her ordinary looks. When she finally chances upon her Korean Prince Charming, she finds that her younger sister too has fallen for the same guy...Youngest daughter Meide is an independent and open-minded graduate who has been spoilt by her father and sisters. While she enjoys the pursuit by her suitors, she does not equate love to marriage. Not until she meets her traditional mother-in-law-to-be and sparks start flying... Like all romantic fairy tales, will the three sisters get married and live happily ever after?

They trusted her. Then, a series of mysterious deaths raised a chilling question: what, if anything, connected them? At the centre of the case is Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, widely known as “Aem Cyanide”, whom police came to suspect in a number of deaths across Thailand. What began as an investigation into individual cases soon widened as police uncovered possible connections between them. Cyanide became a key focus, while questions emerged over money and the ‘sharing circle’ relationships which Aem had with some who died. With rare access to those closest to the case, the series goes inside an investigation that gripped Thailand and left families searching for answers. As new details come to light, it traces how suspicion fell on Aem and examines the evidence that turned a series of mysterious deaths into one of Thailand’s most extraordinary criminal investigations.
